title: How Long Should a Tanzania Safari Be?
excerpt: Three days, a week or two weeks? How long your safari should be depends on what you want to see and how you travel.
body:
## Three days

Tarangire and Ngorongoro, or one area of the Serengeti by plane. See [a three-day safari](/blog/short-safari-3-days/).

## Five days

Tarangire, Serengeti (two nights) and Ngorongoro. A good minimum for the northern circuit.

## Seven days

A relaxed northern circuit with three nights in the Serengeti, or with Lake Natron or Eyasi.

## Ten days or more

Two Serengeti regions, extra parks, or a combination with the south.

## Plus the beach

Add three to six nights on Zanzibar.

## Rule of thumb

Better fewer parks with more time than many parks in a rush.

See [seven days](/blog/tanzania-itinerary-7-days/), [ten days](/blog/tanzania-itinerary-10-days/) and [two weeks](/blog/tanzania-itinerary-14-days/). [Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
